name: LM337
full_name: LM337 three-terminal adjustable negative-voltage regulator (complement of the LM317)
description: Adjustable three-terminal NEGATIVE voltage regulator, the complement of the positive LM317. Output set from -1.2V to -37V by two external resistors, supplying over -1.5A. Recommended minimum input-to-output differential ~2.5V; the metal tab is the INPUT pin.

pins.name: ADJ
pins.description: adjustment; sets output via the R1/R2 divider referenced to the output

pins.name: IN
pins.description: unregulated negative input (Vi); also bonded to the metal tab

typical_application: Adjustable negative rail set by R1 (~120 ohm, OUT to ADJ) and R2, mirroring an LM317 in a split adjustable supply.
gotchas: LM337 pin order is NOT the same as LM317: LM337 TO-220 is ADJ-IN-OUT (pin2=IN, pin3=OUT), whereas LM317 is ADJ-OUT-IN; the IN and OUT pins are swapped between the two
the metal tab is the INPUT pin (negative input rail), not the output and not ground - the LM317 tab by contrast is OUTPUT; this heatsink is live at a negative potential
negative regulator: input and output are negative with respect to ground; the divider sits between OUTPUT and ADJ on the negative rail
needs ~1uF tantalum on input (if far from the filter cap) and ~1uF tantalum (or 10uF aluminum) on the output for stability
